ANA.head: Advantage, the Ducks
ANA.body: Anaheim has been out-chancing opponents lately and has home-ice advantage. The Panthers’ way back in is a penalty kill that holds up.

FLA.head: The Panthers have a hill to climb
FLA.body: Anaheim has been out-chancing opponents lately and has home-ice advantage. The Panthers can pull it off if their penalty kill holds up.
